_comment: Single source of truth for the module catalogue. Edit this, then run: node tools/build-site.mjs

routes.label: Decide if it is worth building
routes.blurb: Is this a real AI problem, and should you build, buy, or kill it?

routes.label: Pick the model and the method
routes.blurb: Which algorithm, which features, which data foundation.

routes.label: Measure whether it works
routes.blurb: The right metric for classical models and for LLMs.

routes.label: Build with LLMs
routes.blurb: RAG, fine-tuning, LoRA, quantization — and when not to.

routes.label: Pass a certification
routes.blurb: AWS AIF-C01, AIP-C01 and Microsoft DP-700.

modules.title: GenAI Foundations Navigator
modules.blurb: A guided tour of the vocabulary everything else assumes: grounding, retrieval components, prompt structure, core parameters, and the point at which fine-tuning starts to make sense.
modules.short: Beginner-friendly tour of GenAI basics: grounding, RAG components, prompt engineering and core parameters.

modules.title: Algorithm Selector
modules.blurb: Work from your problem type and data characteristics to a shortlist of algorithms, with the trade-off that decided each branch stated in the open.
modules.short: Interactive decision tree for finding the right ML algorithm for your problem and data.

modules.title: Feature Engineering Playbook
modules.blurb: Encoding, scaling, outlier handling, feature creation and selection — branched separately for tabular, text, time-series and image data instead of averaged into one rule of thumb.
modules.short: Encoding, scaling, outliers, feature creation and selection across tabular, text, time-series and image data.

modules.title: Metric Decision Tree
modules.blurb: Navigate the landscape of evaluation metrics for classification, regression and ranking, including what to do when your classes are badly imbalanced.
modules.short: Choose the right evaluation metric for classification, regression and beyond.

modules.title: Data Engineering Foundations
modules.blurb: A ten-module, vendor-neutral course running from source systems through ingestion, storage and modelling to decisions people actually trust.
modules.short: Vendor-neutral course through modern data engineering, from source systems to trusted decisions.

modules.title: AWS AI Practitioner Guide
modules.blurb: Study guide for the AWS Certified AI Practitioner exam, with interactive flashcards, service-by-service coverage and quick-fire questions.
modules.short: Study guide with flashcards and quizzes for the AWS Certified AI Practitioner exam.

modules.title: AIF-C01 Practice Exam
modules.blurb: Timed practice exams with 114 questions across all five domains, matching the real AIF-C01 distribution, with an explanation behind every answer.
modules.short: Timed practice exams, 114 questions across all 5 AIF-C01 domains.

modules.title: Visual References
modules.blurb: Diagrams covering confusion matrices, RAG pipelines and the complete LLM lifecycle, drawn for the AIF-C01 curriculum.
modules.short: Diagrams for confusion matrices, RAG pipelines and the LLM lifecycle.

modules.title: AIP-C01 Prep Hub
modules.blurb: Six interactive tools for the AWS Certified AI Practitioner (Generative AI) exam: study guide, flashcards, gap cheatsheet, practice exams and a timed simulator.
modules.short: 6 interactive tools for the AWS AI Practitioner (Generative AI) exam.

modules.title: DP-700 Study Guide
modules.blurb: Interactive study guide for the Microsoft Fabric Data Engineering Associate exam: architecture, ingestion, Delta Lake, KQL, PySpark and the traps that catch people.
modules.short: Study guide for the Microsoft Fabric Data Engineering Associate exam.

modules.title: AI Opportunity Scorer
modules.blurb: Score a candidate use case across six value dimensions and come out with one of four verdicts — build, buy, experiment, or kill — plus the rationale to defend it.
modules.short: Evaluate AI opportunities across 6 value dimensions for a Build, Buy, Experiment or Kill verdict.

modules.title: AI Solution Navigator
modules.blurb: Work from a business problem to a solution class — rules, classical ML, deep learning, generative models, agents, or operations research — before anyone commits to a stack.
modules.short: Navigate from business problem to solution across rules, ML, deep learning, GenAI, agents and OR.

modules.title: GenAI Technique Selector
modules.blurb: Choose the right LLM optimization for your constraint: RAG, fine-tuning, LoRA, quantization, distillation, and the cases where prompt engineering was already enough.
modules.short: Choose the right LLM optimization: RAG, fine-tuning, LoRA, quantization and more.

modules.title: FM Evaluation Metrics
modules.blurb: Pick metrics for foundation-model evaluation — perplexity, ROUGE, BERTScore, RAGAS, LLM-as-judge — and understand what each one quietly fails to measure.
modules.short: Choose LLM evaluation metrics: perplexity, ROUGE, BERTScore, RAGAS, LLM-as-judge.

modules.title: RAG Academy
modules.blurb: A focused course on Retrieval-Augmented Generation: the concepts, the architectures, and the strategies that survive contact with production.
modules.short: Interactive course on Retrieval-Augmented Generation concepts, architectures and deployment.

modules.title: Applied NLP — CSE 8803
modules.blurb: Weekly study notes from the Georgia Tech OMSA course: preprocessing, classifiers, word embeddings, neural networks, RNNs, LSTMs and attention, written as what, why and how.
modules.short: Weekly study notes on NLP fundamentals from Georgia Tech OMSA, with live demos.
